The OS for 
Modern Real Estate
HomePage.subtitle: Aether provides the infrastructure for next-generation brokerages. Manage listings, agents, and transactions in one unified, white-label platform.
HomePage.featuresSubtitle: Replace your fragmented stack with one cohesive platform designed for performance and growth.
HomePage.multiTenantDesc: Instantly deploy branded workspaces for every office or agent. Data isolation and custom domains come standard.
HomePage.customBrandingDesc: Your brand, your rules. Customize colors, fonts, and layouts with our visual editor.
HomePage.securityDesc: SOC2 compliant infrastructure, role-based access control, and automated backups.
HomePage.performanceDesc: Built on Next.js 16 and Neon Postgres. Experience sub-millisecond database queries and instant page loads.
HomePage.solutionsSubtitle: Tailored tools for brokerages, teams, and individual agents.
HomePage.forBrokeragesDesc: Manage multiple offices and thousands of agents.
HomePage.forTeamsDesc: Collaborate on deals and share marketing assets.
HomePage.forAgentsDesc: Build your personal brand and close more deals.
HomePage.pricingSubtitle: Start for free, scale as you grow.
HomePage.ctaSubtitle: Join hundreds of forward-thinking agencies using Aether.
HomePage.footerTagline: The operating system for modern real estate. Built with ❤️ in Thessaloniki.
